Notes
Representative drawing from public product
information; not a manufacturer drawing. Typical of
every instance on the site: the popup names the
instance.
Port n is the n-th of 64 NDR ports, two per OSFP
cage, cages numbered left to right with odd cages on
top (assumed). The site plans do not place the
fabric switches; the card shows where the cable
lands. Hall A only: Hall B's leaf switches are
Quantum-X800 Q3400, which have no detail sheet.

site/details.yaml.
